imagery.vintage: not independently provided by the tile response
imagery.method: Independent Leaflet captures centered at zoom 19; visible station building, parking, apron and access extents estimated from screenshots at recorded scale.

roads.assessment: Mapped road/service-drive centerlines were inspected with imagery as plausibility evidence. A modeled spawn is snapped to a packaged road centerline; this does not verify station gates, apparatus entrances, or access permissions.

limits: No official station parcel or building footprint was used.
Image-estimated fit dimensions, centers and modeled spawn points are not surveyed measurements.
No apparatus door, gate, driveway right-of-way, or emergency access route was independently verified.
Original source coordinates and base IDs are preserved.
For Fire Station 13, nearby mapped service roads did not provide response routes; the modeled spawn uses the connected Fanshawe Park Road East centerline, not a verified station driveway.
